Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1989
ACT V OF 1989
SINDH ASSEMBLY
MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th May, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis-B-2/89, dated 4-5-1989.--The
Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 16th March, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 18th April, 1989 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Assembly Members
(Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of section 6-A in Sindh Act XXVI of 1974

ACT V OF 1989
ACT V OF 1989
SINDH ASSEMBLY
MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th May, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis-B-2/89, dated 4-5-1989.--The
Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 16th March, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 18th April, 1989 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Insertion of section 6-A in
Sindh Act XXVI of 1974: -In the Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and
Allowances) Act, 1974, after section 6, the following new section shall be
inserted:--
"6-A. Medical
Facilities.--A member, a member's spouse, minor children, and unmarried
daughters residing with and wholly dependent on the member shall be entitled to
medical facilities as admissible under the Special Medical Attendance
Rules,1950".
